div.div: M1: Vɢʙ stays fixed. The sweep does not drive the body surface toward accumulation. The small Cgg decrease can come from bias-dependent gate coupling.

div.div: M2: Vɢʙ becomes more negative. Below the flat-band voltage, holes accumulate beneath the oxide; strong accumulation raises intrinsic gate-to-body capacitance toward CₒₓA.
